observations: Photo 0 shows a nameplate reading "SHARP AR-M207" wrapped in plastic film.
Photo 1 shows the same nameplate "SHARP AR-M207" plus a 'digital' logo badge and paper size labels (A4, A3) on a stack of two machines.
Photo 2 shows the same unit from another angle, nameplate again reads "AR-M207", heavily wrapped in plastic, appears unplugged/packed, no power-on state visible.
No screen, toner level, output tray content, or print sample visible in any photo.
Watermark "SMATECH MEGA EQUIPMENT" overlaid on all three photos, suggesting a reseller/dealer listing rather than a private owner.

claims.evidence: Photo 0 and photo 1 nameplates clearly read AR-M207, not M307.

claims.claim: "London use" (implying lightly used, imported used unit)
claims.evidence: No import documentation, usage counter, or UK markings visible in any photo.

claims.claim: "Packed with an extensive range of superb performance functions"
claims.evidence: Generic marketing text copied from a spec sheet; no photo shows functions, control panel, or a working display.

risks.risk: Machine may not power on or may have internal faults (common with used photocopiers shipped wrapped)
risks.proof: A video or photo of the unit powered on, showing the control panel lit and a test print/copy coming out of the tray

risks.risk: Drum, toner, and fuser unit condition unknown (major cost items on copiers)
risks.proof: Clear photos of the drum unit and toner cartridge removed from the machine, plus a printed test page showing print quality
risks.if_unproven: priced as needing full consumable replacement

risks.risk: Actual usage/page count unknown despite 'London use' claim
risks.proof: Photo of the counter/usage screen on the control panel
risks.if_unproven: priced as heavily used, high page count

risks.risk: Cosmetic/physical damage hidden under plastic wrap (cracks, missing parts, broken trays)
risks.proof: Photos with the plastic wrap fully removed from all sides, including the top glass and paper trays
risks.if_unproven: priced assuming visible wrap-covered areas may hide damage

proof_requests: Video of the machine powered on with a live test copy/print produced
Clear unwrapped photos of all sides including the scanner glass and paper trays
Photo of the internal usage/page counter on the control panel
Photo of the toner cartridge and drum unit removed from the machine
response.reason: The unit is clearly identified from its nameplate as a Sharp AR-M207, contradicting the seller's stated 'M307' model, and with no proof of power-on or print function it must be priced at worst case as non-working with unknown consumable condition.
